summary: Round-1 was already approved-with-minor-suggestions. Round 2 re-checks the test changes after the round-1 fix commit (fd6f1ed) which added outage_state.record_outage_event + admin-ping dispatch to the implementation. The corresponding test (test_fallback_publish_outage_error_degraded_then_reraises) was tightened to: mock record_outage_event with a deterministic dict shape, mock send_admin_notification, assert the ping payload was dispatched, and assert ordering record→publish via manager.mock_calls. All four tests still green (4/4 pass). TR-1 (parameterized blocks test) and TR-2 (explicit is_fallback_active patch — found to already be present) remain non-blocking.
